info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Merchant Relationship Management API
info.description: The Merchant Relationship Management API enables businesses to efficiently update and manage their relationships with merchants. Through this API, users can adjust details related to merchant accounts, facilitating smoother interactions and enhanced partnership dynamics. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and corporate partners looking to maintain accurate merchant records and optimize collaboration. It supports critical operations that enhance the overall merchant engagement process.

patch.summary: Update Merchant Relation for a Card
patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a merchant relation associated with a specific card. Utilize this endpoint to modify attributes such as contact information, terms, and conditions, enhancing the collaboration with your merchants.

requestBody.description: Updates details related to the merchant's relations for the specified card. Ensure that the provided JSON body conforms to the required schema to successfully update the merchant information.
